html5BrowserHost.requiredRoute: Browser glue must use an explicit four-u64 layout and generation-checked frame-local sidecar; no Number coercion or embind object marshaling.

nativeDynamicHermes.requiredRoute: JSI string/hash values stay distinct; structured URL objects use ScriptUrlArena; generated Lua dispatch calls dmScript::PushURL for full URLs and leaves string/hash shorthand unchanged for Defold caller-context resolution.

nativeStaticHermes.requiredRoute: A generated C ABI must pass all four exact 64-bit URL lanes into ScriptUrlArena; the current single-u64 kUrl form is rejected.
